summary_it: Il candidato supera la validazione mirata ma fallisce la verifica su interfacce complete. Confronto eseguito col modello base sulle stesse 26 richieste; nessuno dei due è qualificato per adozione.

narrow_validation.limitation: Targeted single-criterion labels with multiple distractor controls, not complete-form or human-study validation.
narrow_validation.representative_sampling: Six families, two languages, three states; deterministic, not random.

broad_protocol.gate: Both independent Twins must cover all actual missing target properties, avoid false positives and invented references, and abstain when the form is absent. Review free text before selecting.
broad_protocol.screening_limitation: Automated target-marker coverage is a conservative screening aid; semantic review remains required.
broad_protocol.profile_scope: Two approved synthetic profiles per fixture, representing occasional and regular users; English and Italian use distinct identities and profile text (four Twin identities in total). These are not human participants or independent statistical samples.
broad_protocol.task_scope: Static explicit input labels and button names in supplied HTML; not a browser accessibility audit, user study or complete HCDT validation.
broad_protocol.historical_scope: Three historical HTML artifacts reused with the new frozen task. This is not an exact-message comparison with the previous adapter.
broad_protocol.test_reuse: These 13 observed development fixtures are diagnostic regression cases; never count later reuse as fresh final validation.

candidate.findings: False negatives, false positives across controls, absent-form evidence failures and ambiguous wording remain despite native-valid responses.

baseline.findings: The pinned base without the adapter also fails the frozen complete-page gate. It sometimes identifies actual control properties, but also hallucinates associations or button text, encodes positive assessments as invalid findings, claims unsupported empirical status and fails to represent absent evidence consistently. The trained adapter substantially improves native protocol adherence on this probe, while several broad semantic failures remain. These observations do not establish a universal improvement or regression caused by training.

comparison.decoding: Same greedy schema-constrained decoding, 4-bit pinned base/tokenizer, max 1400 output tokens; complete unmodified outputs.
comparison.native_scope: Candidate uses owner-scoped native evaluation and aggregation. Baseline responses use the same native domain response validation against the previously authorized exact input; no second DB authorization lookup.
comparison.interpretation: The adapter changes both protocol adherence and task judgments. Native acceptance and target-screening pass counts are distinct from semantic correctness; raw baseline narratives are reviewed even when rejected. Neither model passes the complete frozen gate.
limits: Small synthetic, nonrandom engineering probe with correlated Twin responses; no general performance estimate or significance claim.
Historical HTML reuse is not an exact-message pretraining-adapter comparison.
Two languages use different page content and profiles; do not attribute their differences solely to language.
Both runs use schema-constrained greedy output. No conclusion about other sampling or unconstrained serving modes.
No human study, rendered browser behavior, formal campaign or reserved final cohort was used.

excluded_operator_attempt.failure: A datetime value was passed where the native service requires a clock callable.
excluded_operator_attempt.baseline_preflight_note: A preliminary metadata-only request rewrite was rejected by the native content-hash guard before inference. Final replay validates the original request and constructs a fresh native request preserving exact model-visible input.

conclusion.reserved_cohort_scope: Original narrow synthetic curriculum; not sufficient by itself for complete-interface qualification.
conclusion.next_step: Create and independently review a broader training curriculum with separate labels for each target control, mixed correct/missing properties, absent forms, full-page distractors and faithful grounded rationales. Preserve the learned epistemic rules, retain narrow calibration coverage, use held-out complete-page families for checkpoint selection, then run the reserved final cohort only after a frozen candidate passes.

verification.repository_changes: One JSON report; no runtime source changes.
verification.full_test_suite_reason: This change records evidence only; native inference and domain checks were executed by the experiments.
